subject: The flight deck of the colony ship ariadne at night, two officers on watch, stars in the big window. Michelle's two years are up at the end of the month, and she'd like to stay awake. "I would ask to remain on the watch for a further year, Administrator, provided the rota can bear it, since the baseline we've built would then run unbroken to the end of the crossing and not be left to whoever wakes to read it, which would be a good deal less useful to you at landfall than I could make it. I'd put the cost to my own h Only these two officers are seen clearly; the other four at the table or on the ship are faceless: backs turned, in shadow or cut off by the frame.
